definition_of_done: The assigned public-web discovery shard and UTC window were searched
Primary publications were preferred and upstream lineage was recorded
Canonical URLs, timestamps, language, quote locators, and access failures were recorded
Candidate source profiles and follow-up task proposals were persisted when justified
No final truth assessment, territorial conclusion, or report narrative was added
exclusions: Items already represented by canonical URL, platform ID, or content hash
Access-control bypass, private material, and unsafe non-public geodata
Precise current operational positions or targeting-enabling detail

coverage_gaps: Telegram public previews may not preserve later edits or deletions.
No immutable page or video capture was stored; content hashes and artifact records therefore remain absent.
The two retained posts are source-attributed Ministry statements and were not independently corroborated or assessed.
MAX and VK mirrors were not collected because equally stable, directly inspectable post pages were not located during the bounded pass.
This is a bounded discovery pass, not an exhaustive survey of every Russian federal, military, or regional official account.
result.summary: Recorded two Russian Ministry of Defence Telegram source items published inside the bounded night window. Existing Russian official source profiles were reused; no new profile, immutable artifact, truth assessment, or report narrative was added. A second self-review confirmed timestamp normalization, identifier consistency, source-profile resolution, path scope, lineage disclosure, and safety boundaries.
